text: Charli: WHOA! Someone bounced into my castle! What brings you here?
I've got an invitation for you!
Charli: An invitation?
It's a party! All the monsters are invited.
Charli: Whoooooa YES!! But wait... my sky is so empty. My hot air balloons are all grounded!
I'll help you!
Charli: I've got fire, you've got legs, let's make this work.
Charli: I hereby lend you my fire power!
I just wanted to ask about your castle!
Charli: BOUNCY, right? I slime up the walls so it gets extra squish!
Charli: But without balloons floating around, it's like... only *half* bouncy.
What happened to the balloons?
Charli: They got sleepy. Cold. They need some fire... maybe from my favorite firefriend?
I'll help you!
Charli: I've got fire, you've got legs, let's make this work.
Charli: I hereby lend you my fire power!
I brought you an invitation too!
Charli: Fire up those balloons and I'm *so* there.
Sorry, I think I'm lost.
Charli: That makes two of us! I always get lost when I don't leave any slime behind.
Charli: Fire up those balloons and I'll join your party!
Charli: You did it! The sky looks so colorful again!
Charli: I'll slime straight to your party.
Cloudy: Oh... hello. I didn't expect visitors. Not after what happened with my penguins...
What happened to your penguins?
Cloudy: I was playing with my teleportation magic... and I got too excited.
Cloudy: Now they're scattered across Penguin Land. Alone. Confused.
That's awful! I came here to invite you to a party, but—
Cloudy: Oh... I couldn't possibly celebrate while they're missing.
Cloudy: But if you help me bring them home, I promise I'll come. I'll even bring my color-loving friends.
Cloudy: Here, I'll give you a bit of my power. Just enough to earn their trust.
I brought you an invitation!
Cloudy: A party...? Oh, I couldn't possibly celebrate while my penguin friends are missing.
Cloudy: But... if you help me bring them back, I promise I'll come.
Cloudy: Take this, it'll help you lead them safely.
I have something else do do but I'll be right back
Cloudy: Are they safe? Are they warm? Please keep looking, I know they're out there.
Cloudy: They're home! Oh, thank you! I can't believe they're really back...
Cloudy: I'll come to the party, and I'll bring my best bowtie. The penguins love color.
Fruity: STAY AWAY FROM MY APPLES!
Don't worry I won't take them!
Fruity: Really? Then what are you doing here?
I'm here to invite you to a party with all the other monsters
Fruity: The other monsters? No way.
What happened?
Fruity: They stole my fruit!
That's awful. How about I grow you some new fruit trees?
Fruity: Would you do that for me? That would be amazing
Yes! But only if you'll come to the party.
Fruity: Fine, I'll go to the party if you grow me new fruit trees.
Sorry, I'll come back later
Fruity: Did you finish growing new fruit trees?
Fruity: You made me very happy! Thank you so much!
Fruity: I'll go to the party and bring some fruit with me.
Kitty: Hi, can you help me?
Yes of course!
Can you bring me 5 balloons?
Who are you?
I'm Kitty, nice to meet you!
How's the balloon hunt going?
You brought them all back? Amazing!
Potato: Hello!! Have you come to eat hamburgers with me? Or maybe... to play THE GAME??
I brought you an invitation!
Potato: A party? With *music* and *snacks* and *burgers*?!
Potato: YES. But wait! I can only party with CHAMPIONS. You must first beat me... in HIDE AND SEEK!
Potato: But be warned, when we start, I go POOF! You won't see me until you FIND ME!
I'm ready!
Let's play! I'm hiding near something crispy and DELICIOUS.
What's “THE GAME”?
Potato: THE GAME is everything! THE GAME is the best! THE GAME is... HIDE AND SEEK!!
Potato: I'm the undisputed champion. But if you want me at your party, you'll have to BEAT ME!
Potato: But be warned, when we start, I go POOF! You won't see me until you FIND ME!
I'm in!
First round: I'm hiding near something crispy and DELICIOUS.
I was just looking around.
Potato: That's how all great adventures start! And they end... with potatoes.
Potato: Next, I'll go to a place with clowns and laughter!
I've seen a tent that looks like the right place
Potato: I'm getting hungry, maybe I'll hide near something big and breakfasty!
Breakfast huh? Something made from flour and eggs
Potato: Now It's time for something fun! Let's take a ride
Something to take a ride on. Let's look for attractions!
Potato: You're... too good. I may have to hide inside a sandwich next.
One more time!
Potato: YOU FOUND ME EVERY TIME! I'm officially impressed, and hungry.
Potato: I'll bring mac & cheese and garlands to your party.
